pandas.Series.groupby

pandas 3.1.1 · Series and accessors · method

Split an object by keys to aggregate, transform, or filter each group.

  • Call syntax
  • Run the example
  • Parameters
  • Returns

Call syntax

Series.groupby(…) Full signature
Series.groupby(
    by=None,
    level=None,
    *,
    as_index=True,
    sort=True,
    group_keys=True,
    observed=True,
    dropna=True,
)

Provide either by or level to tell pandas how to group the data. The other parameters are optional.
